classification.difficultyReason: Calculate successive fractional expenditures, using the remaining money as the second whole.

content.prompt: Horatia has saved $\$1500$. If she spends $\frac{2}{5}$ of the money on rent and shopping, and $\frac{2}{9}$ of the remaining money on petrol, how much does she have left?

answer.worked:
Initially, 5 parts represent $\$1500$.

$$\begin{align*}1\text{ part}&=\$1500\div5=\$300\\2\text{ parts}&=\$300\times2=\$600\\\text{Money remaining}&=\$1500-\$600=\$900\end{align*}$$

For petrol, 9 parts represent the remaining $\$900$.

$$\begin{align*}1\text{ part}&=\$900\div9=\$100\\2\text{ parts}&=\$100\times2=\$200\\\text{Money left}&=\$900-\$200=\$700\end{align*}$$
